name: Harvesting the Harvesters
summary: At Saldean's Farm, Ozwin Ironsprocket needs parts for a device meant to briefly override the harvesters' systems. He continues working on the assembly while you gather what he needs.

sections.title: Parts for Ozwin
sections.body: Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm is studying what makes the harvesters work. He believes he can briefly override their systems. You are gathering parts for his device while he continues tinkering with the assembly.

sections.title: The Finished Device
sections.body: Ozwin completes the device and asks you to try it. He stays at the farm, which is beginning to feel like home to him.
